description: Regionalplan Köln - Sachlicher Teilplan Erneuerbare Energien is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opengeodata.nrw.de. The dataset contains the vector data for the drawings of the Regional Plan Cologne - Subplan Renewable Energies in SHAPE and GeoPackage format. The drawing specifications represent bindingly where wind energy areas (WEB are located in the administrative district of Cologne. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Regional Plan Cologne - Sub-plan Renewable Energies" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Regionalplan Köln, NRW, opendata, 1:50.000, Bezirksregierung Köln. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
